- The architect's `jetty brackets` list z=8, y=5; the bracket's back is against the wall at z=9 (facing south).
- Render after every change; judge from the street (`--front n`), check the loft door and hoist, the oven from the yard side, and the roof ridge at y=21.
- Roof overhang at x=5 and z=7 means the roof tool may resize the grid: do `roofMain` with a grid already margined (the lot starts at x=0, so margin exists).
- Run `mcd check`, `mcd walk build.nbt --rooms rooms.json` and `mcd light` before ticking your part.
- Shell (P1): stairHousing runs first so floors skip its cells; stair top step sits in hole cell (7..8,6,14). Brace cells (7,8,8),(15,8,8) and side z=9,14,19,21 at y=8 left unset for P4/P6. Breast (7..9,2,9),(13..15,2,9) left unset for shopWindow. make.sh needs roof.json (Roofs part) before build.nbt is written.

input.summary: Roofs part: parts/roofs.mjs builds the bakehouse wing roof (roofWing, gable, slate, ridge along z at x=19, overhangs N/E/S) and writes roof.json (MAIN_ROOF_SPEC, footprint 6,8,16,22, eave y=10) so make.sh applies the main slate roof once. make.sh finishes and build.nbt is whole. mcd check passes (walkable, nothing floating); the street and elevation tiles show the steep slate roof and timbered gables where plan.md puts them.

waste.what: Worked out whether roofMain and make.sh's main-roof step would both run by reading make.sh, the roof CLI source and vocab.mjs, to see which spec keys (footprint, y) are honoured. Wrote roof.json by hand from MAIN_ROOF_SPEC.
waste.cost: about 4 minutes of source reading before the first build
waste.tool: A single roofs entry point stating whether the main roof is applied in build() or by make.sh, and a make.sh that reads the spec from the vocab rather than a separately written roof.json.

waste.what: Judged by eye from the roof tool report that its 180 removed old-roof cells inside the footprint were not shell cells that matter. Did not verify cell by cell.
waste.cost: one dry-run pass and a glance at the report, no cell-level diff
waste.tool: mcd diff of the shell-only build against the roofed build, grouped by block, would show which non-roof cells the roof tool removed.

left: Main roof top is y=20 but plan.md's ridge is y=21 (the preset gave ratio 1.10, cap 1.8); not adjusted.
Main roof has a ROOF_BIG_PLANE warning: a 17-cell unbroken slope with no dormers or chimney. plan.md accepts this by design.
The roof tool reported removing 180 'old roof' cells inside the footprint above the eave. Not verified: these may include shell cells above y=10 that the plan wants kept. Check with a cell diff.

Wing roof: 5 writes refused as shell cells. (18,7,13) and (20,7,13) want slope stairs but the shell placed white_wool there, (18,6,13) and (20,6,13) are shell wool, and (19,6,13) is the shell king post. The wing gable end keeps the shell's wool, so the top corners of the gable may read flat.
Wing verge overhangs at (19,8,12) and (19,8,23) are orphans by design (mcd check reports them).
